hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#0B192C]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#0B192C]

typography.guidelines: Ensure tight letter spacing for headings to maintain a premium SaaS look. Apply 'font-sans' with Inter for English, and switch to Noto Sans Devanagari for Hindi content dynamically.

visual_enhancers: Borders: 1px subtle borders (border-slate-200) for cards and containers to maintain a clean, flat, fintech look (Razorpay style).
Shadows: Avoid heavy ambient shadows on default state. Use crisp drop shadows or slight lift (-translate-y-1) on hover.
Header: Glassmorphism for the sticky header: 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200'.
Readiness Gauge: Implement a semi-circle or circular progress component that gradients from Saffron to Green.
Empty States: Friendly illustrations (using Lucide icons) with bilingual microcopy guiding the user.
Color Rule: Tinted neutral greys (Slate) instead of pure #000000 or #808080.

components.cards: Use Shadcn Card. Go cardless or use sharp 1px border cards. Avoid excessive border-radius; use rounded-md or rounded-lg maximum.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Generous spacing (gap-6) between form rows. Inputs should have subtle borders and clear focus rings.
components.buttons: Shadcn Button. Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp rectangular (rounded-md). Primary CTAs must use Saffron accent with white text.
components.gauge: Custom SVG or Recharts radial bar for the readiness score.

grids_and_layouts.marketing: Use Bento grid for features. Generous padding (p-12, p-16) and wide gaps (gap-8). Asymmetric spans to break monotony.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High-density Grid Mode B for admin/user portal. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Clear sidebar navigation hierarchy.
grids_and_layouts.mobile: Mobile-first approach. 70%+ mobile users means tables must be horizontally scrollable or render as list cards on small viewports.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.

motion.entrance: Use Framer Motion for staggered fade-up on scheme result cards.
motion.interactions: Smooth state transitions for language toggle and form step progression.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text over Saffron CTA meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use bold weights to compensate if needed.
accessibility.focus: Explicit focus states: 'focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF9933] focus:outline-none focus:ring-offset-2'.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-labels to the language toggle, icon buttons, and visually hidden text for screen readers.

hero_founder.description: Indian startup founder working on a laptop, perfect for hero section.

msme_owner.description: Indian small business owner in a shop, use for targeting MSMEs.

consulting_session.description: Professionals discussing business strategy, for the consulting upsell section.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Always use 'data-testid' on interactive and key informational elements (e.g., data-testid='login-button').
Do not use generic centralized text alignment for layout; left-align forms, cards, and dense text.
Ensure 'prefers-reduced-motion' fallbacks are in place for framer-motion animations.
Keep empty states friendly and guiding, leveraging the bilingual capability.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup a contextual Language Toggle (English/Hindi). Ensure dynamic font switching (Inter <-> Noto Sans Devanagari) across the app.
2. Build the multi-step Onboarding Form strictly using Shadcn form components, ensuring a clean, minimal UI.
3. Develop the Dashboard with Shadcn UI, emphasizing trust and clarity (Razorpay style). Avoid thick shadows; rely on 1px borders.
4. Implement the AI-Matched Schemes as a grid of cards, and build a Scheme Detail Page with a mockup PDF export button.
5. Design the Readiness Score as a visual circular gauge (0-100) using SVG or recharts.
6. Create a consulting upsell interface resembling Calendly for booking, and mockup a Razorpay subscription flow for the ₹499/month Pro tier.
7. Include a functional Admin dashboard with a data table for lead management and CRUD for schemes.
